name: Phantom Ambush
body:
School illusion (phantasm) [mind-affecting]; Level cleric/oracle 4, druid 4, ranger 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one living creature
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

The target believes himself suddenly and completely surrounded by enemies for the duration of the spell. The type of enemy is always appropriate to both the surrounding area and any known animosities of the target. Only the target creature sees the enemies and believes that magic is being used keep others from seeing the new foes.
